name: Palisade Bio, Inc.
summary: Palisade Bio, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, engages in developing oral phosphodiesterase-4 inhibitor prodrugs designed for targeted delivery to the terminal ileum and colon in the United States. Its lead clinical product candidate includes PALI-2108, which is in phase 1b clinical trial to treat patients with inflammatory bowel disease, including ulcerative colitis and Fibrostenotic Crohn's disease.
